about_the_game:
This is the original soundtrack to Heartworm - a retro-inspired survival horror adventure. 60 tracks written for the game by Vincent Adinolfi to accompany the melancholy, emotional, and sometimes terrifying experience.

("Entrance Hall" and "Watermill" by Michael Jentsch, "Back To You" by Michael Jentsch and Vincent Adinolfi)
